name: Five Card Draw
tagline: The classic: five cards, one draw, and plenty of room to bluff.

options.label: Draw four when keeping an ace

rulesSummary: Win everyone's chips. Run out and you're out; the last player with chips wins.
Everyone antes and gets five cards. Betting starts left of the dealer. No limit: bet up to all your chips; the smallest bet is the ante.
If everyone checks, the cards are thrown in, the pot stays, and everyone antes again for a new deal.
The draw: swap up to three cards for new ones, or keep them all. With “draw four” (a lobby option), you may swap four if you keep an ace.
A second round of betting, started by whoever opened, then the best five-card hand wins. Ties split the pot.
Best to worst: straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card. Aces are high, or low in A-2-3-4-5.
Jacks or better (a lobby option): you can't bet first without a pair of jacks or better.
